prespec_audit.note: All pre-specified analyses were carried out as planned.

primary_test.test: two-sided one-sample (paired) t-test of the 16 per-complex differences against zero
primary_test.unit_of_analysis: one complex: its reused native ipTM minus the mean ipTM of its own ten permutations
primary_test.ci_method: Student t interval on the mean; noncentral-t interval on dz
primary_test.direction: positive — natives above their own permutations, the direction H1 registered
primary_test.note: the interval on the mean difference, 0.0278 to 0.1512 ipTM, is the width the primary result is entitled to: a mean shift somewhere between a twentieth and a seventh of the ipTM scale, on 16 pairs.

assumption_checks.primary_test_assumption: normality of the 16 paired differences (the t-test's only distributional assumption once pairing is fixed)
assumption_checks.verdict: normality is not rejected (W = 0.939, p = 0.342); the differences are mildly platykurtic and near-symmetric, and at n = 16 this check has low power, so it is evidence of no gross violation rather than evidence of normality

distribution_free_cross_checks_explorato.note: NOT registered and carries no verdict. Reported only because an assumption check that could overturn the primary test must be shown to have been run: both agree with the registered parametric test in sign and in significance, so the H1 verdict does not rest on the normality assumption.

h3_welch_assumptions.note: Welch does not assume equal variance; Levene is reported because the variances differ by nearly a factor of two (natural 0.0134, designed 0.0249) and that is part of why the contrast is imprecise. Mann-Whitney, exploratory, p = 0.1811, agrees with the registered test in not separating the two sets.

H2_binomial_reference.test: one-sided exact binomial, X ~ Bin(16, 1/11), against the registered count threshold
H2_binomial_reference.note: the plan fixed the threshold at 5 BEFORE the data, and stated in the same sentence that four sweeps would not clear alpha and five would. Four were observed. P(X >= 4) = 0.0511 sits just above alpha = 0.05; the registered verdict is FALSIFIED and the margin is not a licence to move the line.

H3_welch_contrast.test: two-sided Welch t-test, 16 natural differences vs the 13 designed differences of candidate-screen-v8
H3_welch_contrast.note: the interval on the contrast, -0.021 to +0.197, contains zero: the natural mean is 75x the designed mean and the two sets are still not separated at n = 16 vs 13, because the designed differences scatter from -0.277 to +0.275 about a mean of 0.0012 while the natural ones sit 13/16 positive about 0.0895. The registered verdict is FALSIFIED — not detected, not shown absent (confound 7).

sensitivity_not_a_test.note: registered as a comparison, never as a test; alignment mode differs as well as sequence set

reading_verdict.question: does the screen's flat result read as (a) the score does not read design content, or (b) these designed sequences carry no order-dependent content?
reading_verdict.H1_confirmed_licenses: in the plan's own words: the composition-matched null is demonstrated to discriminate on sequences that demonstrably bind, the screen's flat result can no longer be attributed to a score blind to residue order, and the manuscript's proposal of the null as a standard control has its positive control.
reading_verdict.what_it_does_not_license: also the plan's own words: it does NOT by itself decide between readings (a) and (b) for the designed set. Discrimination shown on 7-17 residue crystallised natural peptides transfers to 31-47 residue designed chimeras only by assumption, and that assumption is named in confounds 1, 2 and 3 rather than absorbed.
reading_verdict.reading_supported: the STRONG form of reading (a) — a score blind to residue order everywhere — is falsified: this score reads residue order on sequences that bind. Reading (b) is therefore the reading not contradicted for the designed set, but it is not established, because H3, the contrast that would have established it, is falsified: the missing cell is filled by two studies read side by side, which is what the plan said H3 existed to avoid.
still_unresolved: the weak form of reading (a) — a score that reads order on 7-17 residue natural peptides and not on 31-47 residue designed chimeras — is untouched by this experiment and is not distinguishable from (b) by anything measured here
H2 falsified: per-case use is the form in which the control would actually be applied to one design, and it is not demonstrated. Aggregate discrimination over sixteen is
the null is not the same instrument at the two lengths (confound 3): 10^3.1-10^11.8 distinct arrangements here against roughly 10^26-10^43 there, and m = 10 here against m = 3 in candidate-screen-v8
crystallisation bias (confound 2) makes +0.0895 an optimistic bound on what the null can discriminate, not a typical one
single-sequence mode only (confound 6): nothing here bounds the null's behaviour with a full MSA
ipTM is the model's self-assessment (confound 8): separation on ipTM is evidence about what this pipeline distinguishes, not about what the molecules do
reading_verdict.registered_descriptive_note: the separation is 0.1316 in the 10 complexes the gate placed acceptably and 0.0193 in the 6 it did not, and 0.1293 pre-cutoff against 0.0497 post-cutoff. Both splits were registered as descriptive and carry NO verdict; the pre/post gap is flagged for the discussion because the gate already found recovery itself concentrated pre-cutoff, and neither this study nor the gate can separate era from memorisation.

analysis.analyst_note: Executed against the registered plan only. Every number above was recomputed from rows[] independently of the study module and agrees with it. Nothing outside the registered plan carries a verdict: the distribution-free cross-checks, the Mann-Whitney, the positive-count descriptives and the two stratifications are labelled exploratory or descriptive where they appear. No test was added, dropped, re-directed or re-thresholded after the result was seen.
